notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam: Technical Playtest Begins Now!
notes.content:
We're kicking off our technical playtest today, May 23 – a bit differently than planned.

[previewyoutube=OeL0vvx32zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Due to a pending approval for the dedicated Playtest App, we've decided to launch the Steam Demo version early instead. This version will be updated continuously based on your feedback and will remain available for about one month, including during Steam Next Fest.

[b]What's in the demo?[/b]
You'll experience a slice of a campaign mission with multiple replayable routes. Each run takes between 30 and 60 minutes. Weapons can be ranked up, and attachments unlocked.

[b]What we're looking for:[/b]
[list]
[*] How well does it run on your system?
[*] Did you encounter any critical bugs or crashes?
[*] Are there design elements you’d like to see improved?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/4b37ec36792022fa2d73018e6eaae9840337a769.jpg[/img]

⚠️ [b]This is a work-in-progress. Expect bugs, placeholder content, and unfinished systems. Your input will directly shape how the game evolves.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/09c9c962a47625315bd933e566b6c10ee0809d63.jpg[/img]

🐛 [b]Known & Expected Bugs[/b]
As this is an early work-in-progress build, some issues are known and currently being addressed:

[list]
[*] [b]Unresponsive AI Behavior[/b]
Enemy AI may occasionally fail to react properly. This is often caused by missing information nodes or the inability to find valid cover. We're actively adjusting these systems to strike the right balance between performance and intelligent behavior.

[*] [b]Weapon Rank Display Bug[/b]
In some cases, the in-game weapon rank may appear to reset or decrease after restarting a mission. This is purely a visual issue — your actual progress and weapon stats remain unaffected.

[*] [b]Audio Mixing Incomplete[/b]
The overall sound mix is still under development. Expect placeholder audio, inconsistent volume levels, and general imbalance. This is a key area we’ll be improving over the coming weeks.

[*] [b]Gameplay Lag Spikes[/b]
You may experience minor stutters or lag spikes, particularly when loading new sections of the level. We’re aware of this and working on smoother level streaming and performance optimizations.
[/list]

Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

📥 [b]Download the demo now from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/]Steam Store page[/url].[/b]

I'm very Happy to announce:

[b]United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone expansion to United Assault - Normandy'44 and an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Ardennes.[/b]

As a british paratromy you are assigned to a mission, few would qualify for. You are tasked to infiltrate enemy territory and locate, infiltrate and destroy one of germany's secret V2 factories in the Ardennes. You'll come along heavy enemy resistance, try to weaken their defense by destroying their tanks, equipment and by gathering secret documents.

[b]Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is the newest entry in the Beyond Enemy Lines franchise hitting Steam Early Access in Summer 2022![/b]

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is a modern warfare shooter set in the Quang-Xiong Island, an autonomous island in the east chinese sea.
The island is of great military importance and the source of numerous conflicts. Whoever hasmilitary control over this territory, is in close range to attack china, taiwan, japan, as well as south and north korea.

Satellite intel reports a lot of recent activity on this island and satellite fotos indicate chinese forces occupied the island. China denies this information and confirms that it has not sent any troops to the region. We cannot verify the credibility of the statement, nor can we verify the identity of the occupiers.

We need to get to the bottom of this mess. You need to be careful - we don’t want a major international incident out of this.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Powered by Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen Global Illumination and Reflections
[*] Command your own Squad
[*] Modern arsenal of highly detailed weapons
[*] Large, complex missions with full tactical freedom
[*] Mid mission checkpoints
[/list]
Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is smaller game in scope then Beyond Enemy Lines 2. We target a story set on 3-4 Missions, each lasting for ~60 minutes. We want to test out new stuff with this game, like a own AI controlled squad you can gve orders to and dip our toe into releasing a game with a new Engine - Unreal Engine 5. Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is building the foundation for Beyond Enemy Lines 3 ...

Followed by this are Simulation (14%) and Role Playing (13%) and Third Person Shooter and Action Adventire (12%).

Beyond Enemy Lines - The Role Playing experience? How would this sound to you? We will continue to focus on FPS games but will definitly consider developing smaller games in the other genres in the future.

We also asked which game you would like to see next. notes.title: Server, Security and Anti-Cheat
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dedicated Server[/b][/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will launch with a Multiplayer and so servers are a big topic. You want a quick match with a friend? Just host a Peer-2-Peer (P2P) session from ingame and your friends can join. You want to run a 24/7 Server, then a dedicated server is the best way for you.

Dedicated Server Files are included and you can either start them from within your Beyond Enemy Lines 2 installation with the DedicatedServer.exe or the Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Dedicated Server Tool available in the Tools section or for download with SteamCMD. Dedicated Server files are currently only available for Windows.

Launching the DedicatedServer.exe will open this window:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/79a4a9b13187029633cfd740f7f35eacb08e3751.jpg[/img]

This window let you setup your server. By pressing "LAUNCH SERVER" your settings will be saved and the server will be started. Starting the DedicatedServer.exe will reload your last saved settings. Changing the gamemode will result in reseting the core options to the gamemode default settings. 

[u][b]Server Stats:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Default Tick Rate 60hz
[*] Default Port 7777
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: We had on some systems the issue that opening the Port 7777 was not enought to get the Server registrated on the Steam Master Server. A workaround would be to forward the entire Server.exe trough your firewall. Definitly not an ideal situation but a workaround. The Server.exe to forward is located in this folder:
[i]...\Steam\steamapps\common\Beyond Enemy Lines 2\BeyondEnemyLines2\Binaries\Win64\BeyondEnemyLines2Server.exe[/i]


The Server Manager opens by clicking Server Manager in the Dedicated Server Launcher and will open up this window:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/18dc2ab328f385a9adf84b45b6ace57d9098bc7c.jpg[/img]
This window let you communicated with your gameserver and is until ingame RCON is fully implemented the only way to interact with your server except of shutting it down.

[u]Update Player List[/u]
This will fill the list of players on the right sight of the window with checkboxes for each player.

[u]Kick/Ban Player[/u]
All selected players in the Player List will be either kicked or banned.

[u]End Match[/u]
Will end the current match and the server will switch to the next map.

[u]Server Message[/u]
Will print a message with the sender Admin to the ingame text chat.

Warning: If you execute a new command before the last one was executed, you will overwrite the commands. You can not stack the commands.

Each time you press EXECUTE COMMAND, the tool will request the selected options from the server. As the Server is checking every 60 seconds for new commands, it could take up to 60 seconds until you see the result.

[h1][b]Anti-Cheat[/b][/h1]
[u]VAC[/u]
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 utilizes VAC to detect cheats and hacks in the game as well as Gameban those players.

[u]Anti-Memory Injection[/u]
All important variables are protected against Memory Injection and the game checks for memory injection tools and will crash once such a tool is running.

[u]Server Sided Variables[/u]
All the important variables which are also projected against memory injection are running on the server. Weapon Handling is entire server sided and only result in actions visible to the server. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 does not deal damage on the client side and let the sever confirm this. Here the server gets a request to shoot a weapon from the client and the server checks the players current location, fires the weapon and broadcasts the result.

[u]Global Ban List[/u]
On each Map change, every Server (Dedicated or P2P trough ingame hosting) will fetch a Polygon Art Ban list. This Ban List contains SteamIDs of players with a game ban. Once a Player joins a server, it's Steam ID gets validated. If invalid the player gets kicked instantly. With each update after the release, the then current ban list will be updated and hard coded in the game as a backup, if the online ban list was not successfully fetched.
[b]Warning:[/b] Not only cheating and hacking will result in a game ban. Toxic, racist or other inappropriate behavior ingame or in this community can result in a game ban!

[u]Active Admin + Local Ban List[/u]
Server Admins can activly kick and ban players from their server. Server Bans will result in a Local Ban List which works exactly like the Global Ban List but only for this server. This Local Ban List works for Dedicated and Player Hosted P2P Servers.

notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines 2 | Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/65e18ef5587925321f1f2611a9b26f64629712b4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Release Date[/b][/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-C_OpnAmWHE
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will launch [b]08.08.2019[/b] on Steam featuring [b]2[/b] Story [b]Campaigns[/b], [b]8 unique[/b] (13 in total) [b]Multiplayer Maps across 3 Gamemodes[/b].

[h1][b]Launch Price[/b][/h1]
Normal Price: $24.99
Launch Discount: -20%
[b]Launch Price: $19.99[/b]*
*Or your regional equivalent.

As some of you might know from Beyond Enemy Lines 1, Polygon Art does not join the massive discount sales. This will be the best price you'll get for a long time!

[h1][b]Singleplayer[/b][/h1]

[b][u]Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Campaign[/u][/b]
[u]Content:[/u] 7 Missions
[u]Playtime:[/u] ~10h (on first run, depending on skill and playstyle)
[u]Story:[/u] 
At 06:00 hours yesterday morning contact was lost with Abkhazia, an autonomous region south of the Greater Caucasus. Intercepted radio messages talk about heavy military activity. We still don’t know how it stands on the damages and the origin of the of the occupying forces are unknown.Intel is currently not able to provide any sitrep. All satellites in the region are offline and redirecting satelites will take a while. Until then we are blind. And this is where we are coming in: give us some eyes on the ground!


[b][u]Warhead Campaign[/u][/b]
[u]Content:[/u] 1 Mission at Launch (7 additional following until December 2019 as DLC's)
[u]Playtime:[/u] ~1h per Mission (on first run, depending on skill and playstyle)
[u]Story:[/u]
This mission has top priority. Target: Mikhail Volkov. You are to locate him and bring him out for debriefing. Mikhail Volkov is our only link with the heist of the warhead. Mikhail is held at a military tank base. The whole area has excellent air defenced. We have to place you some distance from the target until those defenses are disabled. You will travel to the next goods yard - there you will resource transportation. The whole operation is simple - there are three stages:

1) Acquire transportation assets.
2) Disable air defences
3) Find Mikhail Volkov and safely extract him for debriefing.


[h1][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h1]
[b][u]Conquest[/u][/b]
A large-scale game mode with up to 32 players fighting for the control of key objectives. The team holding the most objectives is in the lead and will drain the enemies tickets. The team with the most tickets left at the end of a round wins. Kills and objective captures will reward you with money, which can be used to buy new weapons and equipment. There are no predefined classes!

notes.title: Update Release & Development Update | Beyond Enemy Lines 1 & 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

it's time to get you all updated on the current development progress of Beyond Enemy Lines 1 &2, talk about the Linux version of BEL 1.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/947177ff127832d9936f2a4179ccf01347a1d433.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/947177ff127832d9936f2a4179ccf01347a1d433.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1] Beyond Enemy Lines 1 [/h1] 

[u]Update v31260[/u] 
A new update for Beyond Enemy Lines 1 is now available and improves certain elements of the AI, Animations and several other bug fixes.

While Beyond Enemy Lines was released over 1 1/2 years ago I want to update and maintain Beyond Enemy Lines as often as possible. This is truly no longer the pace of last year as the main focus is on the development of Beyond Enemy Lines 2 (more details below).


Here is the changelog:
v31260 Changelog (26. September 2018)
[code]
Weapons:
- improved Weapon field of view while aiming

AI:
- updated Animation transistions
- added ability that AI can now shoot while walking in certain situations
- updated AI aiming visualization

Other
- updated Engine to Unreal Engine 4.20
- updated options to toogle crouch and aim
- removed several minor bugs and glitches
[/code]

[u] Linux Version[/u] 
Bad news first, the Linux version is utterly broken. After weeks of testing, fixing and talking to Epic Stuff and other Unreal Engine 4 developers, the development of the Linux Version reached a dead end.

And here is why:
After weeks of testing, debugging it is still unclear where the stabability issues are coming from. All crashlogs are empty and the reason could be burried within the Unreal Engine 4 code or the game code itself. The source and reason is unknown. Another Problem is that while the continued progress of updating the Windows Version including the Engine version, at some point the map files got incompatable to the Linux version. Which means loading the Map will instantly result in a crash on Linux (reason also unclear) but could be fix be recreating the Map files.

==> All Maps would need a recreation and then the game would still crash for no apparent reason on most systems. The costs at this point are that high that a futher development would never pay the bills.

It's very sad but at this time the Linux Development is on hold. I'll come back to Linux when there is some more time. Rhight now it's just a to massive undertaking for a one man developer.

Sorry Linux gamers, I'll still try my best to make it happen some time.

[h1] Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Development Update [/h1] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is on a good way, it's big, it's loud and growing fast!
I'm developing mostly in silence on a truly amazing sequel to Beyond Enemy Lines.

[b]All critics of the original game was heard and improved.[/b]
Gunplay is a lot more thigh and gives the player more feedback, AI reacts more realistic, Missions are larger, more complex and by far more detailed.

And with Beyond Enemy Lines 2 we will have the [b]first true night mission[/b].

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/79d0771ff376f98b453a0f3b7903d1a18e415b43.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/79d0771ff376f98b453a0f3b7903d1a18e415b43.jpg[/img][/url]

Beyond Enemy Lines offers a lot more unnanounce features, a hughe amount of content and other cool stuff which will be announced an shown in the next weeks.

[b]Comparison of the same map from 2015 and 2018[/b]

notes.title: Welcome to Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Combat Sandbox Evolved
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/669af815995741b46025dd8e63eca187509a8be0.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/669af815995741b46025dd8e63eca187509a8be0.jpg[/img][/url]
(click for 4k version)

[h1][b]What is Beyond Enemy Lines 2?[/b][/h1]
[b]A hardcore Combat Sandbox![/b] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 enters the path prepared by the predecessor and evolves into a fully fledged singleplayer combat sandbox with total freedom.

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[b]Combat Sandbox Evolved[/b] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 offers a unique mix of endless possibilities with total freedome and no handholding. Sneak around enemies or go in guns blazing, use the physics to defeat opponents and customize your weapon appropriate to the situation. You have the freedom to choose your path!

[b]Realtime Weapon Customization[/b] 
Customize your weapons in real time on the battlefield with various parts to ensure it suits your playstyle.

[b]Smart-AI-System 2.0[/b] 
Developed from scratch, the Smart-AI-System 2.0 provides dynamic combat situations with a smart, unpredictable AI. All issues of the predecessor got removed and new features like squad management and advanced weapon handling where added.

[b]PC Game[/b] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is a PC Game! No compromise! 4k Resolution, 4k Textures, 144 FPS, higly customizable!

[b]Tactical depth easy to control[/b] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 offers more tactical depth and interaction then ever before. Yet it's easier to control then equivelant games. Intuitive and fluid!

[b]100% Hardcore[/b] 
Going beyond the enemy lines means carefully considered and skillful actions. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is hardcore PC game developed against AAA industry standards. Don't expect positive reinforcement and a rank up for opening a door. You will only survive with skill, tactical knowledge and patience!

[h1][b]What is different to Beyond Enemy Lines 1?[/b][/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is an evolution of Beyond Enemy Lines 1 and will change a lot of things introduced in the first game. While the original Beyond Enemy Lines was a spiritual successor to Project IGI and stick very close to it's roots, Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is no longer "limited" in this way and is a more complex and evolved tactical FPS.
[i](Personal note: I just don't like to develop a sequel which is more or less a reskin of an existing game with only 1-2 changes)[/i]

One thing which got removed first was the [b]Map Computer[/b] as it is no longer required to plan your tactics. Missions are designed in a clearer and more readable way and the introduction of customizable weapons required some rebalancing. Out of the same reason the [b]carried weapons are limited[/b] to a primary and secondary weapon as well as a backup pistol. In other words you can carry only 3 weapons at a time.

The player [b]movements[/b] were expanded by adding lean and prone funcionallity. [b]Weapons[/b] handle like real weapons and fires into the direction of where the barrel is pointing at. Which means each move of the weapon affected the bullet impact location. 

Oh and one more thing ... weapons do no longer clip trough objects!

[h1][b]Multiplayer?[/b][/h1]
[b]Yes? No? Possible![/b] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is a singleplayer game just like Beyond Enemy Lines 1. But I heard your request of Multiplayer and Coop and Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is developed with Multiplayer in mind. Due to the fact I'm still a single person developing the game, I have no resources to develop Singleplayer, Multiplayer and Coop at the same time in a decent quality. Singleplayer first and then we will see. A small Multiplayer Prototype is up and running and it's very possible to see the Multiplayer as a seperate spin off game at a later date.

[h1][b]Lootcrates & Microtransactions[/b][/h1]
No way!

[h1][b]Release?[/b][/h1]
[b]When it's done![/b] 
No seriously, when it's done! Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is currently in pre alpha stage and there is so much to do and to check out that it's nearly impossible to give a date. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will start an open and community driven development in 2018 and will be released once the quality is right.

[h1][b]What's next?[/b][/h1]
[b]Open and Community driven development in 2018![/b]

Missions are designed in a clearer and more readable way and the introduction of customizable weapons required some rebalancing. Out of the same reason the [b]carried weapons are limited[/b] to a primary and secondary weapon as well as a backup pistol. In other words you can carry only 3 weapons at a time.

The player [b]movements[/b] were expanded by adding lean and prone funcionallity. [b]Weapons[/b] handle like real weapons and fires into the direction of where the barrel is pointing at. Which means each move of the weapon affected the bullet impact location. 

Oh and one more thing ... weapons do no longer clip trough objects!

[h1][b]Multiplayer?[/b][/h1]
[b]Yes? No? Possible![/b] 
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is a singleplayer game just like Beyond Enemy Lines 1. But I heard your request of Multiplayer and Coop and Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is developed with Multiplayer in mind. Due to the fact I'm still a single person developing the game, I have no resources to develop Singleplayer, Multiplayer and Coop at the same time in a decent quality. Singleplayer first and then we will see. A small Multiplayer Prototype is up and running and it's very possible to see the Multiplayer as a seperate spin off game at a later date.

[h1][b]Lootcrates & Microtransactions[/b][/h1]
No way!

[h1][b]Release?[/b][/h1]
[b]When it's done![/b] 
No seriously, when it's done! Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is currently in pre alpha stage and there is so much to do and to check out that it's nearly impossible to give a date. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will start an open and community driven development in 2018 and will be released once the quality is right.

[h1][b]What's next?[/b][/h1]
[b]Open and Community driven development in 2018![/b]

notes.content:
[h1]Beyond Enemy Lines shines in new light![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/6ad9f82045f298151fc50cd70106a23d3d911d26.jpg[/img]

A new update improving the visuals of Beyond Enemy Lines is now available for free. New Tree mdoels, improved, post processing , new character models and improved animations as well es a reworked gunplay let to one of the larges updates for Beyond Enemy Lines ever! Read all changes in the attached changelog below.

[h1]Performance:[/h1]
While improving the overall visuals the goal was to keep the same system requirements as before for the highest settings. While the update perform very well on most of the systems, some older GPUs can have issues with the enhanced post processing. Reducing the post processing quality in the options should solve most performance issues.

-> The new medium settings are equal to the highest in older versions. Please take a few moments to adjust your settings if necessary.

If you want to play the old version or have any issues with the new visuals, a new [b]legacy branch[/b] is now available in the Beta tab within the properties (Steam).

[code]Graphic:
- replaced pine tree models
- rescaled remaining tree models
- added light shafts
- reworked post processing

AI:
- fixed animation issues
- added new character model dedicated for enemy snipers
- added 4 new character models randomly picked for non snipers

Weapons:
- rescaled all weapons
- repositioned weapons (closer to the player)
- reworked gunplay (recoil, spread, accuracy, damage output)

Other
- added new player animation system
- fixed crouch to stand animation transistion
- attached Player View to new player animation system
- added menu character can randomly selectes character mesh
- added mnew loading and preview screens
[/code]

notes.title: Upcoming Update - Free Mission Facility + Status Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/5ada614945ee32dabfae6d7783adfa4d2c6872e8.jpg[/img]

The third free content update introduces the mission [b]Facility[/b] to Beyond Enemy Lines. Facility is a large scale mission with a total of 5 mission objectives and is starting a [b]new era of mission design[/b] in Beyond Enemy Lines.

[b]Facility Release:[/b] soon (in verification at Valve)

[h1]Boosting the Performance:[/h1]
Alongside with the Facility Mission the new performance update goes live which is enhancing the light propagation and the general performance by ~15% due to the introduction of proper multithreading. The Material System is also switched from traditional Diffuse Material to [b]PBR Material[/b] allowing a more natural look with more depth in textures while keeping the same system requirements (VRAM) and performance as the old system.

In other words: [b]Beyond Enemy Lines looks now better then ever with an even better performance![/b]

[h1]New Possibilities:[/h1]
The new one performance allows new possibilities like a more dense vegetation. Facility is the first mission taking advantage of those new possibilities and is able to draw double the amount of vegetation with a higher view distance than previous missions.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/ce418246ebdb76f85b89b556bb8770a715e8f24a.jpg[/img]

[h1]The last one of it's kind:[/h1]
Facility is the first mission to benefit from the performance bust but will also be the last one showcasing the old Landscape look. I'm working hard on a new way to render and display landscapes in a more natural and realistic way. The fourth free mission (yes there will be another one) will feature a realistic landscape look later this year.

[h1]Mission Editor:[/h1]
Good news for all creative players waiting for the Beyond Enemy Lines Mission Editor. All critical bugs (AI) are resolved and the Editor is fully working. But there is still some work left to do:

[list]
    [*]remove visual, non critical bugs
    [*]improve editor controls
    [*]finalize workshop tools
    [*]write tutorial guids and tooltips
[/list]

[b]Editor Release:[/b] within the next weeks

notes.title: The future of Beyond Enemy Lines & Polygon Art
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
I think it's about time that I say a loud THANK YOU to all of you! Since the release of Beyond Enemy Lines back in february it was a very stressfull but amazing time. You created an amazing, friendly and constructive community for which it's a pleasure to work for! Everyone who contributed their thoughts, ideas, reported a bug or just played Beyond Enemy Lines - thank you very much! It was a long journey and it's not over ...

[h1]The future of Beyond Enemy Lines[/h1]

[b]Updates:[/b]
I'm currently working on updating the Engine from Unreal Engine 4.13 to 4.16 and reworking parts of the code to allow propper multithreading (where possible and supported). This worked payed off very well and resulted into a [b]performance boost of ~15%[/b]. I'm also researching the possibilities of reworking all material shaders for an enhanced graphics, if - when - how is unknown and will be announced in the near future.

I'm also working on the [b]next free Mission Update[/b] which is adding another large scale map to Beyond Enemy Lines.

Ubdate release date: TBA

[b]Mission Editor:[/b]
The Mission Editor es developing in a solid state and is pretty much fully usable. The associated Workshop tools are in the final state and are 95% done and working properly. But as always with such big projects someone won't cooperate. In this case: the AI.

I hoped to have solved all remaining issues of the AI by today but unfortunately not. The AI is almost fully functional, gets spawned correctly, is reacting properly to the Player but for some reason won't patrol along waypoints. To make it even stranger - if I create a mission in a Preview Build running withing the Unreal Engine 4 Editor, the AI is working. If I load this mission into a standalone build used in a Steam Beta Branch the AI works fine and moves along the waypoints. Only if a mission is created from within a standalone build, the AI won't work properly.

So there are still some problems but I hope I'm able to sort the out in the next days. I'm planning to release a [b]public beta of the editor in June 2017[/b] with a limited amount of assets (all remaining assets will be added later with free updates).

[h1]The future of Polygon Art[/h1]

[b]The Next Game Project (TNGP):[/b]
I'm proud to announce that Polygon Art is currently working on a new Project which will be revealed later this year. This also means that most of the resources and work are now redirected the the new Project and there is less time available to work on Beyond Enemy Lines. This will result in a large time span between new updates for Beyond Enemy Lines. But don't worry, the support for Beyond Enemy Lines won't stop and more content is planned to be released over the next month.

[b]Polygon Art Value:[/b]
I'm also very proud to announce Polygon Art Value, a newly foundet team of 5 higly talented game design students. Working together with me as the Project Lead, the goal of Polygon Art Value is to develop small and entertaining game for various platforms.

The first project is set to be released this summer. If you don't want to miss any details about new Polygon Art games, make sure to follow Polygon Art on social media.

notes.title: Upcoming update coming along with Expansion
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/86103a672f9be2050968fc6d78e6b611d40edd37.png[/img]

The first expansion for Beyond Enemy Lines will be released this month and along with it's release there will be a major update available for the base game. Here are all the changes:

[list]
    [*]added new Campaign selection screen
    [*]added 4 new weapon slots for the new expansion weapons
    [*]added editor core code (but currently disabled for public use)
    [*]added new DLC licence check system
    [*]added new achievements for DLC owners
    [*]reworked several sounds
    [*]remove >100 non critical warnings in the code
[/list]

The update addes all Operation: Arctic Hawk related files als well as all Editor files to the base game. DLCs from now on contain ownly a licence check to unlock ingame items and no additional downloads are required. This decision was made due to fact that the editor needs always all files and a seperat download wouldn't change much. So the filesize will increase around 1GB to 6GB in total.

The owners of the Military Airfield Donation DLC and Dome Donation DLC will recieve an additional supporter achievement the next time the mission is completed.

notes.title: Announcing: Expansion Pack & Mission Editor
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/5aa4695580225ff7a1354bf5e50f7780d3cae58b.png[/img]

Beyond Enemy Lines will recieve it's first paid expansioncalled [b]Operation Arctic Hawk[/b]. It comes with a 4 mission long new Story set in siberia after the events of Beyond Enemy Lines.It introduces a winter themed graphical set and 4 new weapons as well as dynamical weather changes and a night mission.

Operation Arctic Hawk will be a paid expension, wether the price is not set, expect it to be under $10. This expansion does not only serve the purpose to add more content to the game, it's helps to [b]fund[/b] the continued support and the [b]development of the ingame editor[/b] introduced in the next part.

All changes and improvements apply to the main game and will be updated uppon the release of Operation Arctic Hawk. There will be free mission updates for Beyond Enemy Lines after the release of Operation Arctic Hawk and the Editor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/f75dc383a1626346facdcf14d661d7eb05eea7a3.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/80f5b5dd0ee4c79b9cac7aab7b3b5f1f0549177f.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/d1fdf899e2e5212af1e99357111193a6b8e834c9.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/bee29cb211c65874c108141c096595fbe043a0b0.jpg[/img]

[b]Content:[/b] New Story with 4 Missions, 4 new Weapons, new graphical set
[b]Release Date:[/b] TBA
[b]Price:[/b] TBA


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/5ab4242207ff33d8dacb3383c19b15255bab5486.png[/img]

[h1] Create your own mission and share it with our friends and the community![/h1]

A frequently requested features arrives for Beyond Enemy Lines - The Mission Editor! Create your own Mission with the build in Editor within minutesand no programming knowledge is required!

Drop the Objects you like into the mission. Move, rotate or delete them, change the landscape and day of time on the fly. Playtest it directly within the editor and if your creations works just fine, upload it to the [b]Steam Workshop[/b] and share it with your friends or the entire Beyond Enemy Lines Community.

A fully fledged and detailed mission as a filesize of <10mb, even with slow internet you are able to share and play missions.

Early Work in Progress demonstration: [b] Build a mission in under 3 minutes[/b]
[url=https://youtu.be/0oiEL4hdB9c] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/e3de65a3fccddfcc4dd0260361bb544661c0e570.png[/img][/url]
The Editor will be [b]released for free[/b] to every owner of Beyond Enemy Lines with full Steam Workshop integration and the graphical set of the main game. More graphical sets like the Winter set from Operation Arctic Hawk could be added later on.

[b]Release Date:[/b] TBA (after Operation Arctic Hawk)
[b]Price:[/b] free

notes.title: Update v30300 released - AI and Weapon Update
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGyCuwNGKqruzeg/giphy.gif[/img]

v30300 Changelog (03. April 2017)
[code]
Weapons:
- slightly increased damage of all weapons
- reworked bullet physics
- resized bullet size to a more realistic size
- reworked sniper recoil
- added bullet trace to sniper bullets
- reworked hit registration (from AI accept damage to bullet deal damage)

AI:
- reworked AI code
- purified Cover Search Algorithm (Runtime O(n^3) -> O(n^2))
- removed 2 deadlocks in state machine
- AI nolonger starts by default, now gets called by AI-Manager when ready
- increased hear radius from 1200 to 1650
- AI can now react to nearby bullet impacts (depending on surface and distance -> reaction is randomized, bullets can be ignored or path to "check impact" is to long)
- AI now returns smoothly when hear or see player (somethimes rotates long way -> needs additional research)
- AI is now playing a fire animation when shooting

Other:
- cleaned and improved code
- added casual option to settings menu
[/code]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGvkTOMIY80XJBK/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Feature Update - Weapon & AI Improvements
notes.content:
Beyond Enemy Lines will recieve a Feature Update in the next days to improve the overall feeling and handling of the game and to prepare it for the next big Content updates which will be announced in April.

[h1]What will be improved?[/h1]
[list]
    [*]reworking and cleaning programm code which can improve the performance a bit 
    [*]new Damage Model - Hit registration is now working in a faster and more precise way
    [*]reworked Projectile ballistic
    [*]reworked Sniper handling and adding tracer bullets
    [*]several AI Improvements - reworking reaction time, improving several algorithms
    [*]implementing optional casual mode
[/list]
[h1]Casual Mode:[/h1]
A new, additional difficulty mode for unexperienced players or those who just want an easier experience. The Casual Mode is optional and needs to be turned on specificly in the settings menu. It will reduce the numer of AI's in a mission as well the damage caused by the AI. 

[h1]Release Date:[/h1] TBA

notes.content:
As the new mission Military Airfield was released this tuesday, I want to give you a first look into the upcoming feature update.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/964d86eb3383f1a5589f0ae06d81208bc4dc8174.jpg[/img]

[h1]What is the difference between a feature update and a content update?[/h1]
A feature update improves existing features and extends them, tweaks bugs and enhances the overall gameplay. While content updates introduce entirely new content like new missions.

[h1]What will be improved with the next update?[/h1]

[h1]Trainyard improvements:[/h1]
The Singlemission Trainyard was the first mission ever created for Beyond Enemy Lines. Even if it's a legacy mission the age and some failures in the layout are noticeable. With it's close quater set up and limited routs, Trainyard does not fit perfectly into the mission structure of Beyond Enemy Lines. To accomplish a new and better feeling, the Trainyard gets a small extension to open more routes and possibilities.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/393458b99b1273cf0cfd47328e4a1735efb4d28e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Light improvements:[/h1]
On almost all Missions the light and shadow casting get's a slightly overhaul to improve the shadow distance and enhance the atmospherical effects.

[h1]Full Controller Support:[/h1]
As of now, Beyond Enemy Lines provides partly controller support. With the upcoming feature update Beyond Enemy Lines can be completly played with a controller and all menus will becontrollable with a gamepad or the keyboard (Settings menu is an exception, this still needs a mouse).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27810587/a3e038c02b1fa83acefe73895dc794f696ff2363.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Text-Message-System:[/h1]
A new Text-Message-System will be integrated and supports translated text. The update will ship with english language only, so at first there will be no visible change for you, but the full language support will be added later.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
This update will come with over 100 Bug fixes and smaller improvements.

[h1]Release date:[/h1] March 2017 (exact date: TBA)

notes.title: Welcome to Beyond Enemy Lines! – FAQ
notes.content:
In this short FAQ I want to answer the most asked questions and give you a short, brief overview of what Beyond Enemy Lines is.

[url=https://youtu.be/mT_wc3O1FGc] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/523610/extras/store_banner_01.png?t=1486999314[/img][/url]

[h1]What is Beyond Enemy Lines and what can I expect from it? [/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines is an combat sandbox shooter. You are the director, you choose how it plays and what you experience. If you expect a story driven, highly scripted run and gun shooter, Beyond Enemy Lines is not the game you are looking for. You will die a lot if you play without tactics and run blind into a gunfight. It takes patience and dedication to beat this game, which makes it stand out among casual titles. 

[h1]How many missions will be available? [/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines will launch with an eight missions long campaign and two special standalone missions, with a combined average playtime of 10-15h on the first playtrough.

[h1]Will there be free missions updates after the release? [/h1]
Yes! Several new missions, each with an average playtime of 1h, will be added for free after the release.

[h1]Update frequenzy? [/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines is developed by a single person, so expect that the work on an update may take some time. I’ll communicate the work in a dedicated post.

[h1]System Requirements? [/h1]
The system requirements are quite high, this is caused by the AI system that as no precalculated data. It calculates everything on runtime and is therefore able to react to each situation. If you are ok with playing at <60FPS you can lower the requirements for you.

[h1]Will there be a Multiplayer? [/h1]
No, there are currently no plans for Multiplayer.

[h1]How is the Beyond Enemy Lines development team set up? [/h1]
The structure is extremly simple, the game is developed by a single person.

[h1]What is Beyond Enemy Lines's relationship with Project IGI 1 and 2? [/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines started as Project IGI Reloaded, a fan recreation of Project IGI 1 and developed into a full, standalone game. The core gameplay is nearly identical with some light additions and improvements.
